name: Walchand PeopleFirst Limited
about: Walchand PeopleFirst Limited provides consulting and training services to individuals and employees of corporates in India. The company offers learning and development, human resource consulting, and education and skilling, as well as corporate social responsibility social projects. It serves civil construction, shipping, agriculture, automobiles, finance, and aerospace sectors. The company was formerly known as Walchand Capital Limited. Walchand PeopleFirst Limited was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Walchand PeopleFirst Limited operates as a subsidiary of Walchand and Company Private Limited.
